nodes.label: MarkerIPCWorker (marker_ipc_worker.py)
nodes.rationale: Persistent warm-worker subprocess. start()/restart() create the worker via _make_process with daemon=False because daemon processes cannot spawn children and Marker's ONNX/torch pipeline spawns internal workers; worker lifecycle is managed explicitly via shutdown poison-pill/terminate.

nodes.label: daemon=False Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause of 'daemonic processes are not allowed to have children': worker was created daemon=True; paper 1 succeeded but paper 2 hit an internal code path needing child-process spawn and failed at parse_seconds=0.0. Fix changed _make_process default and start() to daemon=False, covered by TestMarkerIPCWorkerDaemonSafety and TestProcessNextIPCDaemonSafety.
